great.name: Bariatric surgery covered (after waiting period)
great.quote: 13. Bariatric Surgery: Hospitalisation Expenses incurred for bariatric surgical procedure and its complications thereof are payable... after a waiting period of 24 months.
great.explanation: Bariatric surgery is explicitly covered (many policies exclude it); coverage starts after 24 months as per policy terms.

great.name: Consumables / non-medical items covered (List I) when claim is admissible
great.quote: 6. Coverage for Non-medical Items (Consumables) : If there is an admissible claim under the policy, then Items as per List I speciﬁed in this policy will become payable
great.explanation: Non-medical consumables listed in List I become payable when the hospitalization claim is admissible, reducing out-of-pocket expenses.

good.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with insurer.
good.reference: Section III (Exclusions) > 1. Pre-Existing Diseases - Code Excl 01 (Page 7/12)
good.explanation: PED coverage starts after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is standard/good in the market.

good.name: Specific disease / procedure waiting period: 24 months

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (not for accidents)
good.quote: 3. 30-day waiting period - Code Excl 03 (Not Applicable for Accidents)
good.explanation: Illness claims have a 30-day initial waiting period, which is industry standard.

good.name: Automatic restoration: 100% once; usable for subsequent hospitalizations (including same illness)
good.quote: 16. Automatic Restoration of Sum Insured : There shall be automatic restoration of the Sum Insured once by 100%... Such Restored Sum Insured can be utilized for all claims for subsequent hospitalization during the policy period.
good.explanation: Restores 100% once in a policy year after partial/full use. Can help when base SI gets exhausted; applies for subsequent hospitalizations.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 60 days
good.quote: 9. Pre-hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days immediately before the insured person is hospitalized.
good.explanation: Covers eligible pre-hospitalization expenses for up to 60 days (standard-good).

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 90 days
good.quote: 10. Post Hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 90 days immediately after the insured person is discharged from the hospital.
good.explanation: Covers eligible post-hospitalization expenses for up to 90 days (standard).

good.name: Air ambulance covered (with limits)
good.quote: 8. Air Ambulance... reimbursement... up to  Rs.2,50,000/- per hospitalization and maximum upto Rs.5,00,000/-  per policy year
good.explanation: Air ambulance is covered with defined caps, which is a useful additional benefit.

bad.name: Room rent has a daily cap (and % of SI cap) + proportionate deductions can apply
bad.quote: 1. Room, Boarding and Nursing Expenses up to 1% of sum insured or maximum up to Rs.20,000/- per day whichever is less... Note: Expenses relating to Associated Expenses will be considered in proportion to the eligible room rent/room category stated in the policy schedule or actuals whichever is less.
bad.reference: Section II (Coverage), point 1 (Page 3/12) + 'Associated medical expenses' definition (Page 2/12)
bad.explanation: A capped room rent (1% of SI or ₹20,000/day) can restrict hospital choice and may trigger proportionate deductions for associated expenses if you choose a higher room category than eligible.

bad.name: Disease sub-limit: Cataract has fixed limits
bad.quote: 5. Expenses incurred on treatment of Cataract is subject to the limit as per the following table
bad.explanation: Cataract is covered but with sub-limits per eye/per policy year, which can increase out-of-pocket if the hospital package is higher.

bad.name: Modern treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured
bad.quote: 14. Coverage for Modern Treatment... upto 50% of sum insured speciﬁed in the policy schedule (including Pre and Post hospitalization expenses) during the policy period;
bad.explanation: Modern treatment coverage is not at full SI; it is capped at 50% of SI, which may be limiting for high-cost advanced procedures.
